Please keep an eye in your AI-generated graphics and proofread before publishing, I found two glaring errors:
1. It’s Santa Rosa Island, NOT Santa Roza Island.
2. The flag shown on the Spanish explorer’s ship is incorrect. The correct flag is a white field with a jagged red “x” across it. The red/yellow/red flag didn’t exist till almost 500 years later. 

Great content though, but info on the establishment of a bison herd on Catalina with animals left after a movie shoot is worth a mention. They became too successful, so much so that bison were later exported to re-establish Great Plains herds on native lands. The population of animals  on Catalina are now tightly controlled with birth control being used to keep birth rates down.
